Drag either pane. Arrow keys move the focused pane; Shift moves faster, Home resets it.

This glass layer composition lab draws text once into a canvas. Each pane samples the layers below it with the site's WebGL renderer. The hero artwork contributes one completed canvas layer.

Visible layers: background lighting and tiles, sampled text, rear glass pane, front glass pane. The HTML label is always separate.

Interactive WebGL lab loads when nearby. Enable JavaScript to change these settings.
